status: registered before execution; data preparation for P1 (design doc §8.3), no model result
region: hiroshima (all 864 non-error tiles; positives and negatives)
source: Sen12Landslides NetCDF, ALL 15 acquisitions in arrival (acquisition) order, real dates, including cloudy ones (SCL clear fraction kept as quality q_i). No top-12 clear selection.

outputs_per_tile.single_fp16: (15,768,32,32): OlmoEarth v1 base single-observation state per acquisition (1-timestep window), same crop/pool/band contract as the sealed cache
outputs_per_tile.prefix_fp16: (15,768,32,32): full re-encoding of the arrival prefix [max(0,c-12):c] for c=1..15 (encoder max 12 timesteps; older observations drop off) — the cost reference and teacher for the causal update

why: P1 requires causal arms that never see future observations or quality; the sealed cache pre-selected the clearest 12 using the whole year, which is a lookahead. This extraction removes that lookahead.
cost_note: encode units per tile = 15 singles + sum(min(c,12)) for c=1..15 = 15 + 78+36 = 129 timestep-units vs 12 for the sealed cache; ~26k crops-of-4 on GPU0, est. 60-90 min

amendment_1.change: same extraction contract applied to additional single-event regions for EVENT-LEVEL holdout: thrissur (2018-08-07, 427 tiles), itogon (2018-09-15, 235), hokkaido (2018-09-06, 290). Script generalised with --region; hiroshima outputs unchanged.
